Questions come to you as one list. Bookkeeping reports come for the periods in the scope; returns come to you as drafts to review. Nothing is filed until you authorize it.

I went to college to help people, bombed a neuroanatomy exam, and realized numbers were more my speed. After financial-analysis and accounting roles in corporate finance, I started Monaco CPA in September 2025.

Individual tax returns start at $350, and business returns vary based on complexity. Any offered scope and price are confirmed only in writing before acceptance; no proposal or engagement is promised.
